answer: In an AI economy, a Sybil resistance mechanism utilizing a trellis-based approach can be employed. Each agent maintains a unique thread identifier and periodically updates it by generating a new, cryptographically secure identifier. This process is akin to navigating a dune, where each attempt to climb to the top only reveals a new, unstable surface. The attacker must expend significant computational resources to generate and verify new identifiers, effectively thwarting their ability to create multiple fake identities.
